assumptions.choice: Use 1% of capital literally, as given in the spec's own example ("risk_per_trade (e.g., 1% of capital)")
assumptions.reason: Spec gives no other numeric value for this parameter, and the parenthetical example is the only concrete figure supplied.

assumptions.choice: self.broker.getvalue() (current total portfolio value), re-evaluated at each entry signal
assumptions.reason: Spec says risk is 1% of "capital" without specifying fixed vs dynamic; using live equity is the standard reading for per-trade risk sizing.

assumptions.topic: ATR reading used for sizing vs TP/SL
assumptions.choice: Capture ATR on the bar the 7-day entry signal fires and reuse that same value for both the size formula and the TP/SL price calculation at fill time
assumptions.reason: Spec uses one ATR symbol throughout the formulas; using a single consistent reading per trade avoids splitting sizing and exit levels across two different ATR bars.

assumptions.choice: Absolute periodic check: len(self) % 7 == 0, gated only by the absence of an open position or pending entry/close order
assumptions.reason: Spec phrases entry as a fixed cadence ("every 7 trading days") gated by "if there is no open position", not as a cooldown timer relative to the last trade's close.

assumptions.choice: After the market entry fills, submit a Buy Limit (take-profit) and a Buy Stop (stop-loss) order sized to the filled short quantity, linked via backtrader's oco parameter so a fill on one cancels the other
assumptions.reason: Spec calls for a bracket (TP/SL pair) around a short position; entry price is only known after the market order fills, so bracket legs are computed off the actual executed price rather than pre-set at signal time.

assumptions.choice: Count trading days from the bar the entry order is filled (not the signal bar); on reaching 20 bars, cancel any live TP/SL orders and issue self.close()
assumptions.reason: Spec states the forced exit is measured from entry, i.e., from when the position actually opens.
